steps.en: Index the repository without an API key
steps.zh: 给仓库建一次索引，不用 API key

steps.en: Parses every file with tree-sitter and builds the graph, git, health, dead-code and wiki layers locally
steps.zh: 用 tree-sitter 解析全部文件，在本机建出五层索引

steps.en: Wires your agent: writes a repo-root .mcp.json and registers context hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json
steps.zh: 自动接线 agent：写 .mcp.json、注册 hooks

steps.en: Ask your agent to answer from the index
steps.zh: 让 agent 从索引里直接回答

steps.en: Answers with cited, graph-grounded context over MCP, stamped with index age and a staleness warning
steps.zh: 通过 MCP 返回带引用、标注索引新鲜度的答案

value.en: Your agent stops grepping and re-reading the same files to rediscover callers, risk and health on every task
value.zh: agent 不用再每个任务都靠 grep、重读同一批文件去重新发现调用方、风险和健康度

sources: README.md 'Start in minutes (no API key)': pip install repowise; repowise init --no-prose -y; repowise serve; ask 'Use Repowise get_overview to summarize this repository'

docs/start/QUICKSTART.md sections 1-3: keyless init builds graph, git, health, dead-code and wiki locally ('No LLM calls, no key, no network'); init writes a repo-root .mcp.json and registers repowise with ~/.claude/settings.json unless --no-editor-setup
docs/agent/HOOKS.md: agent hooks read only local SQLite (wiki.db) and git, no LLM calls, no network
README.md 'The ten MCP tools': each response's _meta carries index_age_days, indexed_commit and stale_warning
